trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Expect roughly 200 hours in a single playthrough (PowerPyx rates the set 4/10); the long pole is the gold for 100% completion, not the story. No online play, no difficulty setting and no DLC are involved.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: it unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed — just play the story. PowerPyx confirms it as automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It pops as the story moves into Chapter 2 (PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 2). Nothing to do beyond playing the story, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. PowerPyx places the unlock at the start of Chapter 3 (after its first main mission, Welcome to Vice City). Just keep playing the story; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life). Unmissable — it comes with story progress.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. PowerPyx places the unlock after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Unmissable — it comes with story progress.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: it unlocks when you finish the final mission (PowerPyx ties it to the same closing mission as Chapter 4's end, Starting From Zero). Automatic and unmissable — the last story beat before free-roam cleanup begins.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable — just play the mission when it comes up in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — it pops with the mission, no side requirement.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Unmissable — it unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Unmissable — it pops with the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable — it comes with the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable — it pops with the mission, near the end of the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: finish the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only appears after the story — but progress made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than true 100%: roughly 60% of the game, needing 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges and drone races, plus any 70 of the 80 challenges. Nothing on the checklist is missable; everything is doable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — you can mix the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridge flights the quickest. Track progress per region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icons). Most come naturally while working on the other trophies, so PowerPyx advises not to worry about it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx links a dedicated guide to all 12 range locations and the 42 golds; the medals are not very difficult, and the ranges also feed your Focus level. All ranges are still available after the story.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). PowerPyx links a dedicated guide to all 14 locations. Drone races are also part of the 100% checklist, so this comes along with the post-story cleanup.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Any race type counts; repeat wins at the same location do not. Races also count toward the Master of None activity set, so fold this into the post-story cleanup.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing challenge marked with a purple icon on the map west of Key Lento. Go to that spot and beat him at fishing. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (they can be briefly unavailable during some story sections, then return); Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of a game once — no need to beat every challenge inside it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest optional line, which is Lucia-only: it is marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls Lucia and texts her home address in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line: it is marked automatically in Chapter 1, and after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map; dive to the shipwrecks, dig the treasure up with the metal detector and bring it back — 7 shipwrecks in total across several sets. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so it is not missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest optional line at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County: it is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. The quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — but only certain questlines count: the character lines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) do NOT count as strangers. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing and mentoring) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile deliveries), with more still being found. Track your count in the trophy list itself; all of them are still there after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: it is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Granforma Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered (track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; Randy is marked with a green RK icon in west Vice City). Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage in good condition for better pay. Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street — sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's two-quest line, which is Jason-only: it is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go there and destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations — meditating with both Lucia and Jason at a spot counts as +2. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. You cannot do the last one until both characters are playable together (after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break). WARNING — possibly missable: the very first meditation only happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. It raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required; PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 trophy list
sources.what: Second source flagging this as the only possibly missable trophy.

trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1. Do it before Chapter 1 ends: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony. It is unconfirmed whether it is required — PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting line, which is Jason-only: it is marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Bret then marks hunting spots with purple map icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). One clean shot keeps an animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Still available after the story; PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, and that completing all 15 Target Decks is needed for the 100% checklist anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx links a dedicated guide to all 18 card set locations; the cards are scattered across Leonida and are tracked as a collection. You do not need every set — three is enough for the trophy, so pick the sets whose cards you find first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK locations: hold up on the D-pad and R1 to scan objects in the world. There are far more than 100 — PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — so any 100 count. Scanning vehicles and landmarks as you play the story already builds the total.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (8 groups of 10). Track them under Progress > Challenges — each one shows a Completed checkmark. Most complete naturally while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, which needs 70 of 80; leave this for late, then pick the easiest ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone (not just the flashing search area). PowerPyx's easy route: a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since the large bank vault robberies always give 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner, then rob 3 shops in a row while keeping the red/blue flashing wanted level — never let it drop. Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and carry Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The unlock is delayed: it pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop, and if it does not pop, hit a 4th shop. PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, which open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs in the back room, and do not leave the first store before the police arrive.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. Use the WAiNK app from your phone (hold up on the D-pad to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. The fastest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops automatically on the way there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak points are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must down 5 enemies in one use, and the window only lasts a few seconds. PowerPyx's setup: boost focus first (eat or drink, or wash up at home), take Adrenaline to extend the effect (hold L1, press triangle), wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and line up 5 enemies at a gang operation — an assault rifle like the Duke 556 works best, and it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); it grows by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game and may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — planes parked on the open airfield do not count. PowerPyx's easiest one is docked at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get straight inside (you can also walk in through the terminal). Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons) on the map. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — never kick the door, which triggers the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm; the trophy pops shortly after you leave. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (it is marked automatically from story progress): tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry the cash briefcase in and the vault to open, then go in and rob it — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold right on the D-pad to hand off a bag). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip about security vans (he is the fence from Chapter 3; do his Payday Loans quests first if needed) and follow the purple-marked vans to banks. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. Any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs count, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way; a single vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is — the same mission that opens bank vault robberies — because robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. It also works earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks; block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). Either way, the trophy only unlocks after you escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still black fog on the map until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx links a dedicated guide for the quickest plane and route. Exploring as you play also counts, so much of it may already be done by the time you reach the post-story cleanup.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (there are 39 operations in total). They are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops automatically on the way there.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. PowerPyx's guide shows the bar and the drink; it is a small one-off moment, not a grind — do it whenever you are in Vice City.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car — the blue Banshee — from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs: hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and keep driving — the unlock is slightly delayed and pops once you are further down the street. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow open the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. If you miss one during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go back for the remaining valuables — it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, the heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership, filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities, and always go together with your partner (hold right on the D-pad, press triangle to call them): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — you can see the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something counts. Robberies done stealthily, destroying evidence and clean escapes push you toward Professional; incapacitating enemies is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing or driving over gravestones is Psycho; and Irredeemable is permanent if you keep using excessive violence. It happens passively while working on the other trophies — if it is still short at the end, PowerPyx notes it can be farmed quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car, though at Psycho or Irredeemable cops are more likely to shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honestly: no source has yet documented how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner; the store is in Little Cuba, Vice City. Do not trust any method that cites no source yet; check the PowerPyx guide again — it is updated as launch-era information arrives — before spending time on guesses.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed. If a blinking car is at the roadside, the UFO can be triggered — follow the path into the woods next to it and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside and the trophy pops. If the blinking car is not there, drive away and come back later.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded, like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are dense enough to chain ten kicks inside the minute.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). You need $250,000 delivered in total, counted across all robberies, not in one go. It comes naturally with the other robberies; bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, though they only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive purchases. PowerPyx counts the shop types: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. It accumulates across the whole game, so it often pops on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are also 4 story-related garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garage space — each garage adds one or more parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
